provenance: Questions in this file were adopted from the MIT-licensed project Onesayi/ccna-simulator at commit 6efca4f15e8ccf01fb44973b46bb26922797965a (Alistair Nhiwatiwa, 2026-10-04), originally authored against the CCNA v1.0 blueprint and re-keyed here to the v1.1 leaf objective IDs in src/data/objectives.json. The full per-question mapping, including every item dropped as out of scope and the reason, is in docs/ADOPTED.md. Each question records its origin in its `upstream` field.
